53. There are a number of significant reasons why women do not leave dangerous partners.
Victims can be at a higher risk when they leave violent partners. There are other ties to their
homes, including identity, family, money and status, which operate as strong motivators for
staying in a violent relationship. There can be complex psychological reasons at play; an
